description: The agent DESIGNS + SCOPES how to make recognition better, from its OWN measured evidence — no teacher. Its arc established one principle that pays (MARGINALISE a genuinely-uncertain structural latent: parse +1.0) and several that do not (marginalising a DETERMINED latent hurts; an addable LEARNED cue fails, 6x; a simple learned prior plateaus). design_marginalise APPLIES the proven principle to NEW ground: for every structural latent the agent believes UNCERTAIN but has NOT yet marginalised, it mints a Direction 'marginalise <latent>' with expected_gain = its measured proven-lever payoff x the latent's uncertainty — the agent generating research directions from its own evidence. score_direction ranks every direction (designed + the ambitious/rejected ones the host stages) by expected_gain; recommend/reject is read off the sign. The DECISIONS are Rules over the agent's evidence.

microtheory.name: recognition_design
microtheory.description: design + scope recognition improvements from measured evidence
